name: Planning with Files
description: Implements Manus-style file-based planning to organize and track progress on complex tasks. Creates task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

promptPatterns: \b(planning with files|文件规划|plan (out|with files)|multi-?step planning|project planning)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the planning-with-files skill: create and maintain task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md to plan, break down, and track the complex task; recover context from these files on session start.
